artifact.cluster_ci95_note: 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals over source chunks (2000 resamples), informational

corpus.carve_bytes_source: sealed cache identity (sha256 of y and g); the cache carries no build metadata

artifact.fit_record_top1_is: each fit record's top1 and top1_non_gutenberg are over the concatenated 260000 + 832 scoring set; per_family is over the sealed evaluation rows only, because extension rows carry an 'ext:' family prefix

partition.fit_order_rule: np.random.default_rng(20260825).permutation of the fit corpus's rows, so the recipes' last-10% validation split is a random tenth rather than one family
partition.row_identity_digest: blake2b-128 of the contiguous float32 feature row, over every scored row

cache_identity.X_note: the builder cache's FEATURE array, hashed for the first time here. Every earlier preregistration sealed only y and g of this file, so no gate read a single feature byte of it: the split is a function of y, g and the seed, and every block hash is over row indices. 0021's collision rule is about that array, so the array is now sealed directly and the rule corroborates rather than carries it (0021 pre-freeze review, condition lens, finding H2). Costs about 8 seconds at launch.

protocol.expected_collisions_source: artifacts/pivot/builder_duplicate_chunks.json, banked 2026-09-16 after 0020's refusal; the 9 duplicate chunk pairs and the 32 straddling row pairs are named there

fit_corpus_described.convention: n_chunks in fit_corpus is the number of source chunks that CARRY ROWS, which is what the runner measures (1029); 1035 chunks were selected and 6 of them produced no row because every one of their 26 streams fell below the 4096-byte carve floor. The sealed extension corpus uses the same convention (n_chunks 2387 with rows, 2400 built).
fit_corpus_described.selection_rule: every whole 32768-byte chunk of each pinned blob that 0018's sealed selection (n_per_family 300, seed 20260909, recomputed here from tools/pivot/corpus_ext.py) does not use, in blob order, minus every chunk whose bytes hash to a sealed chunk's or to an earlier fit chunk's; no seed of its own

protocol.reference_source: artifacts/pivot/deflate_curve.json rungs[n_units=100000].accuracy, the rung preregistration 0016 reproduced in this environment (artifacts/pivot/fdc_4096.json incumbent_100k_refit_top1)

floor_feat1.why: the single most informative feature, thresholded by a depth-1 tree; `best_single_feat`

floor_majority.why: always predict the most frequent label of the fit block; tools/trivial_baselines.py's `majority`

floor_stratified.why: sample from the fit block's label prior, ignoring the input entirely; `stratified`

floor_tree3.why: a decision tree of depth 3 - a rule a person could write out by hand; `depth3_tree`

incumbent.why: 0003's incumbent verbatim (run_study.py make_model 'hgb', run_carve.py's explicit last-10% validation split); every other parameter at the sklearn 1.9.0 default

logistic_l3.why: standardised inputs with C 1.0: the single most standard fix for an lbfgs logistic on 1108 unscaled hand-engineered columns

model.why: capacity plus regularisation plus a lower rate together: 800000 rows x 26 classes supports bigger trees than 63 leaves, and the deep-tree baseline gained 0.1459 -> 0.1812 from depth 8 to 16 at 4096

captured_from: tools/pivot/run_realfit.py --stage run --smoke against prereg/0021-realfit-4096-rerun.json's own smoke block (scratchpad corpora sealed in smoke.ext_corpus/fit_corpus), 2026-09-16
why: the shape of tools/pivot/run_realfit.py's artifact, captured from a smoke run of the runner itself so the realfit4096 mutation gate builds its control from the RUNNER's output shape rather than from the reader's expectations (docs/OPERATING_RULES.md section 4). Values here are the smoke's and are replaced by the gate wherever the run is sealed; the keys, the nesting and the record fields are the fixture. The gate asserts this key set BOTH ways against the control and against the reader, so a runner that grows or drops a field breaks the gate instead of passing it - the previous fixture was already two partition keys stale and the one-directional check could not see it.
